label: lem:lpf_exists
title: Existence of a least prime factor
statement:
For every integer $m\ge 2$, there exists a prime $p$ such that $p\mid m$ and
    for every prime $q\mid m$ one has $p\le q$.
proof: By well-ordering of the naturals, the set of prime divisors of $m$ is nonempty (since $m \ge 2$) and has a minimum element.
